text: The Enabling Environment for Disaster Risk Financing in Cambodia: Country Diagnostics Assessment is a technical publication by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) that provides a comprehensive diagnostic of Cambodia’s policy, regulatory, institutional, market, and data prerequisites for establishing and scaling disaster risk financing solutions. It aims to map the strengths and gaps of the enabling environment to help the Royal Government of Cambodia and development partners sequence reforms and investments that pre-arrange finance for disasters and reduce fiscal volatility from shocks.
